_doc: Trigger-accuracy fixtures. Each prompt is phrased as a user would actually type it. `expect` is the skill that should load; `reject` names neighbours that must NOT outrank it. Lexical overlap is an approximation of the model's choice, not a simulation of it -- but two descriptions that are lexically indistinguishable for a prompt are descriptions the model will also struggle to separate.
